findings.message: stateful resource deleted (removed from configuration) -> data loss; all objects are lost (the delete fails on a non-empty bucket unless force_destroy = true)
findings.suggestion: Snapshot or back up the data first. Add lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } to stateful resources. If this is a rename or refactor, use a `moved` block instead of delete+create. For replacements, check whether the attribute can be changed in place (e.g. allow_major_version_upgrade).
